features.title: Useful Language

badge.title: A1 LEARNING PATH
badge.text: Build the sentence patterns you need before talking about places and everyday needs.

tip.title: How to study
tip.text: Learn the examples aloud, complete the quiz, then produce your own answer without copying the model.

sections.title: Core words and phrases
sections.description: Flip each card, listen, and create one personal example.

cards.definition: They live in a small flat.
My bedroom has a large window.
Our home is small but comfortable.

tip.title: Recall practice
tip.text: Cover the English term, read the Vietnamese meaning, and retrieve the full phrase from memory.

sections.title: Grammar bridge
sections.description: Master the structures that connect this A1 module to the next stage.

points.title: Be: identity and description
points.function: Use am/is/are with nouns and adjectives.

points.title: Have got / has got
points.function: Use have got to talk about family and possessions.
examples: She has got a new phone.

points.title: Possessives
points.function: Use my/your/his/her/our/their before nouns; use ’s after a person.
examples: Their house is near the park.

tip.title: Accuracy first
tip.text: Notice the verb form in every example, then change the subject or time expression to make a new sentence.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.description: Choose the best answer, then read the explanation.

questions.explanation: Brother is singular, so use is. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
We takes have got. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

questions.prompt: This is Hoa. ___ room is upstairs.
questions.explanation: Hoa is female, so use her. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
The phrase is belong to. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
Use Have they got...? Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
Use parents’ for something owned by both parents.

tip.title: Use the clue
tip.text: Look for time expressions, the subject, and words before or after the gap before choosing.

sections.title: Listening: My Family and Home
sections.description: Listen for the main idea, then listen again for details.

audio.transcript: Hello, I'm Ben. I live in a small house with my parents and my younger sister, Lucy. Our house has two bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom and a living room. My favourite room is the kitchen because we eat and talk there every evening. Lucy's favourite room is our bedroom. She keeps her books and toys next to her bed. We also have a little garden behind the house. My father grows tomatoes there.

gistQuestions.explanation: Ben describes who he lives with and the rooms in his home.

detailQuestions.prompt: Why does Ben like the kitchen?
options: The family eats and talks there
detailQuestions.explanation: His family eats and talks in the kitchen every evening.
His father grows tomatoes in the garden.

tip.title: Listening Tip
tip.text: Listen for family words and room names first; focus on small details on the second listen.

sections.title: Build a spoken answer
sections.description: Answer each question aloud. Aim for a clear answer plus one reason or detail.
questions: What is your favourite room and why?
sections.sampleAnswer: There are four people in my family. We live in a small flat. My favourite room is the living room because it is bright and comfortable.

tip.title: Speak in layers
tip.text: Start with a direct answer, add a reason, then give one example or detail.

sections.title: Independent writing
sections.description: Introduce your family and describe your home to a new online friend.

prompt.situation: Write about the people in your family, your rooms, and one possession that is important to you.
prompt.referenceAnswer: There are four people in my family. We live in a small flat. My favourite room is the living room because it is bright and comfortable.

tip.title: Final check
tip.text: Check verb forms, word order, spelling, and whether every sentence helps answer the task.
